findings.description: Clara González Pimienta and Benjamín Silva Díaz had a daughter, Zulema de Jesús Silva González, born 12 November 1897 and registered at Pichilemu, Colchagua, Chile.
supporting_sources: Chile, Civil Registration, 1880-1933 — birth registration of Zulema de Jesus Silva Gonzalez, born 12 Nov 1897, registered at Pichilemu, Colchagua, parents Benjamín Silva Díaz and Clara Gonzalez Pimienta
